en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a two‑story wooden school building with a central tower, steep hipped roofs, and decorative trim. The school stands behind a low post‑and‑rail fence in a rural landscape, with mountains and evergreen trees in the background, a tall flagpole, and a utility pole in front. A horse and buggy or wagon appear near the entrance steps. Handwritten text is visible along the bottom edge of the image.
